name: Zach Woods
bio: Zach Woods (born September 25, 1984) is an American actor and comedian. He is best known for his run as a series regular for three seasons on The Office US, playing the role of Gabe Lewis, and his role as Jared Dunn on the HBO comedy series Silicon Valley. He also recurs on the HBO series Veep and on the USA Network sitcom Playing House, as well as the HBO show Avenue 5.
